title: Temporal raises $550M at a $12.55B valuation
summary: Temporal, a developer platform for durable execution of code and workflow orchestration, has raised $550 million in Series E funding at a $12.55 billion valuation, positioning itself as a key infrastructure player for AI agent workflows and distributed systems.
problem_solved: Enables developers to build fault-tolerant, long-running workflows and distributed applications that can survive infrastructure failures and scale seamlessly
why_valuable: Addresses the critical need for reliable, persistent execution platforms required by AI agents and complex distributed systems in enterprise environments
